task: Polish: checkboxes and radios squashed on phones by the reflow min-width:0 rule
errors: First before/after layout script measured before pages settled after a resize; a no-op rule showed phantom moves up to 220 px. Fixed by polling until two readings agree.
Full platform/pages suite: 1 failure ('an identical build produces an identical cache name') because I wrote the run record into the tree mid-build; passes alone.

doc_friction.issue: Suggested a shared input{min-width:0} at all widths; measuring it showed it squashes checkboxes in flex labels, and the existing phone-only version already did, on 287 pages. The suggestion needed a checkbox/radio exclusion.
Build start line `cmd > build.log; echo DONE >> build.log` wrapped in `( ... ) &` under run_in_background detaches, so the task notifies at once; plain run_in_background without & is right.

deviations.why: Did not ship the suggested all-widths input min-width:0; it squashed checkboxes.
deviations.did: Fixed the live phone-width checkbox squashing it revealed instead, and left the mid-width rule for a re-measure.
deviations.result: 423 to 2 (false positive) squashed boxes at 320 px, 172 to 2 at 390 px.

notes: Catalogue count: 8,984 pages built locally, Chromium at 320/390, checkbox/radio squashed if width < height - 0.5. After measured with patched built pf-chrome.css/pf-site.css on the 287 flagged pages; sideways: none at 390, 4 pre-existing at 320 (same with original CSS). reflow.test.mjs 22/22; platform/pages suite 1560 pass, 1 fail (mid-run edit, passes alone), 25 skipped.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: front-end dev: catalogue-wide Playwright measurement, CSS fix, tests, screenshots and write-ups

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
